title: Pico 4 loses positional tracking
shortDescription: Inside-out tracking fails in low light or reflective rooms.
fullDescription: Pico 4 and Pico Neo uses four tracking cameras. Poor lighting or featureless environments cause tracking loss.

fixSteps.title: Improve lighting
fixSteps.instruction: Turn on bright diffuse room light.

title: Pico Motion Tracker not paired
shortDescription: Controller is not recognized by headset.
fullDescription: Pico controllers pair via Bluetooth to the headset. Pairing can be lost after firmware updates.

faq.q: Do Pico controllers have rechargeable batteries?

title: App crashes to home
shortDescription: Game or app unexpectedly quits back to Pico home.
fullDescription: Crashes often stem from outdated apps, low storage, or thermal throttling.

title: Firmware update fails
fullDescription: Fails due to insufficient battery, weak Wi-Fi, or low storage.
whenToCallPro: If headset bricks, contact Pico support.

title: Display appears very dim
fullDescription: Thermal throttling or sleep mode may cause the display to dim.

title: Wi-Fi randomly drops
fullDescription: Pico Wi-Fi can drop on 2.4GHz. Prefer 5GHz.

title: Built-in speakers silent
fullDescription: Audio routing issues after Bluetooth pairing or firmware bugs.

title: Headset overheats and shuts down
fullDescription: Long sessions or hot rooms cause thermal limit.

faq.a: Yes, clip-on fans help in summer.

title: PC VR stream stutters
shortDescription: Wireless streaming from SteamVR PC lags.
fullDescription: Pico Streaming Assistant requires dedicated 5GHz band and strong signal.

fixSteps.title: Use dedicated 5GHz AP
fixSteps.instruction: Connect PC via Ethernet and headset to dedicated 5GHz.

faq.a: Yes, USB-C link is more stable.

title: Safety boundary not remembered
fullDescription: Pico cannot reuse boundary if environment changed, or if storage data corrupted.

fixSteps.title: Clear and redraw
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > Safety > Clear boundary, then redraw.

faq.q: How many boundaries can I save?
